name: scrub
description: A local ffmpeg GUI. Drop a file in, pick an operation, get a file out.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @scrub/shared && npm run build --workspace @scrub/server && npm run build --workspace @scrub/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @scrub/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @scrub/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @scrub/client && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @scrub/shared && npm run test --workspace @scrub/server
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run build && npm run test && npm run test:e2e
